_README: Expected modules come from the official SRM 21CSS101J syllabus (curriculum/srm_21CSS101J_scope.json), which lists each topic under one unit. IMPORTANT ASSUMPTION: this only works if each corpus file is named/organised by unit (e.g. unit_2_pointers.pdf, or via data/raw/pps/curriculum_map.json) so the 'module' metadata is 'Unit N'. A file that mixes several units cannot be scored at unit level. 'What is a pointer?' is listed under Unit 2, but Unit 3 also covers function pointers, so a Unit-3 hit on that query would count as a miss. Review the expected values once the real files are in. expected_topics is left empty on purpose: topic labels depend on the headings in the real material.
